immense pressure: Before the final exam, many senior high students are under immense pressure to get into a top university.
期末考前，許多高三學生承受著考上頂尖大學的巨大壓力。
be of immense value: These old letters are of immense value to historians because they describe daily life a century ago.
這些舊信件對歷史學家極具價值，因為它們描述了一百年前的日常生活。
immense wealth: The businessman made immense wealth from his tech company, but he still lives in a small apartment.
這位商人靠他的科技公司賺得巨額財富，但他仍住在一間小公寓裡。
take immense pleasure in: My grandfather takes immense pleasure in growing vegetables and shares them with all the neighbors every summer.
我爺爺從種菜中獲得極大的樂趣，而且每年夏天都會分送給所有鄰居。
be immune to criticism: After years in politics, the mayor seems immune to criticism; nasty comments online no longer bother him at all.
從政多年後，市長似乎對批評無動於衷；網路上的惡毒留言再也影響不了他。
be immune from prosecution: As a foreign diplomat, he was immune from prosecution, so the police could not arrest him for the accident.
身為外國外交官，他免於被起訴，所以警方無法因這起事故逮捕他。
the immune system: Getting enough sleep and eating fresh fruit can help keep the immune system strong during flu season.
在流感季節，充足的睡眠和吃新鮮水果能幫助保持免疫系統強健。
immune to disease: No one is completely immune to disease, so washing your hands often is still important.
沒有人能完全對疾病免疫，所以勤洗手仍然很重要。
be immune to change: No company is immune to change; even the biggest brands must adapt to new technology or disappear.
沒有公司能不受改變影響；即使是最大的品牌也必須適應新科技，否則就會消失。
an incentive scheme: The company started an incentive scheme that gives workers extra money when they reach their sales goals.
公司推出了一項獎勵計畫，員工達成銷售目標時就能拿到額外的錢。
incentive payments: The government offers incentive payments to farmers who stop using harmful chemicals on their fields.
政府提供獎勵金給在田裡停止使用有害化學物質的農民。
tax incentives: The city offers tax incentives to encourage companies to build new factories and create more jobs here.
該市提供租稅優惠，鼓勵企業在這裡蓋新工廠並創造更多工作機會。
an incredible story: The old sailor told us an incredible story about surviving alone on an island for three months.
老水手告訴我們一個難以置信的故事，關於他獨自在島上活了三個月。
incredible pressure: Professional athletes face incredible pressure to win, since millions of fans are watching every move they make.
職業運動員承受著難以想像的求勝壓力，因為數百萬球迷看著他們的一舉一動。
an incredible achievement: Climbing Mount Everest at the age of seventy was an incredible achievement that made headlines around the world.
七十歲登上聖母峰是一項驚人的成就，登上了世界各地的頭條新聞。
It seems incredible that…: It seems incredible that people once lived without cell phones, yet just thirty years ago most families had none.
人們曾經沒有手機也能生活，這似乎令人難以置信，然而僅僅三十年前大多數家庭都沒有手機。
be indifferent to suffering: How can anyone be so indifferent to suffering and simply walk past the hungry children without a second look?
怎麼會有人對苦難如此無動於衷，看都不看一眼就從飢餓的孩子身旁走過？
an indifferent performance: After an indifferent performance in the first half, the team played much better and won the game.
上半場表現平庸之後，這支球隊打得好多了，並贏得了比賽。
indifferent to public opinion: The leader seemed indifferent to public opinion and passed the unpopular law despite huge protests in the streets.
這位領袖似乎不理會輿論，儘管街頭有大規模抗議，仍通過了這項不受歡迎的法律。
be indigenous to Taiwan: The Formosan black bear is indigenous to Taiwan and cannot be found living in the wild anywhere else.
台灣黑熊原產於台灣，在其他任何地方的野外都找不到。
indigenous peoples: Taiwan's indigenous peoples have lived on the island for thousands of years, long before other settlers arrived.
台灣的原住民族早在其他移民到來之前，就已在這座島上生活了數千年。
indigenous culture: The festival celebrates indigenous culture through traditional songs, dances, and food of the Amis and Atayal tribes.
這個節慶透過阿美族和泰雅族的傳統歌曲、舞蹈和食物來慶祝原住民文化。
indigenous species: Scientists worry that foreign fish released into the lake will eat the eggs of indigenous species.
科學家擔心被放生到湖裡的外來魚種會吃掉原生物種的卵。
be indispensable to: Clean water is indispensable to human life; without it, we cannot survive for more than a few days.
乾淨的水對人類生命不可或缺；沒有水，我們活不過幾天。
an indispensable tool: For today's students, a laptop has become an indispensable tool for doing research and writing reports.
對現今的學生來說，筆電已成為做研究和寫報告不可或缺的工具。
make oneself indispensable: Lisa made herself indispensable at the office by learning every system and helping everyone solve problems.
麗莎學會了每一套系統並幫大家解決問題，讓自己在辦公室變得不可取代。
indoor activities: On rainy days, the camp offers indoor activities such as painting, board games, and cooking classes.
下雨天時，營隊會提供繪畫、桌遊和烹飪課等室內活動。
an indoor pool: Our school has an indoor pool, so students can take swimming lessons even in the cold winter months.
我們學校有一座室內游泳池，所以即使在寒冷的冬季，學生也能上游泳課。
indoor plants: My apartment gets little sunlight, so I chose indoor plants that grow well without much light.
我的公寓日照很少，所以我挑選了不需要太多光線也能長得好的室內植物。
